commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
for archive in base.tar day2.tar day3.tar; do
  printf '\nCONTENTS %s\n' "$archive"
  for entry in $(tar -tf "$archive"); do
    case "$entry" in
      /*|../*|*/../*|*'/..') printf 'UNSAFE PATH: %s\n' "$entry"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    printf '%s: ' "$entry"
    tar -xOf "$archive" "$entry" | sed -n '1,20p'
  done
done

commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
stage=$(mktemp -d /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain/.recovered-stage.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$stage"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
tar -xf base.tar -C "$stage"
for archive in day2.tar day3.tar; do
  tar -xOf "$archive" deletions.txt | while IFS= read -r path || [ -n "$path" ]; do
    [ -n "$path" ] || continue
    case "$path" in /*|../*|*/../*|*'/..') printf 'unsafe deletion path in %s: %s\n' "$archive" "$path" >&2; exit 1;; esac
    rm -rf -- "$stage/$path"
  done
  tar -xf "$archive" -C "$stage" --exclude=deletions.txt
done
[ ! -e recovered ]
mv "$stage" recovered
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'RECOVERY_CREATED\n'
find recovered -xdev -printf '%y %M %u:%g %s %P\n' | sort
